evidence.reason: Left edit drops metering.initialize() and changes the plan literal from "monthly" to "benchmark"; no supplied test asserts the initialization side effect or the "benchmark" plan, so joint reliance is unproven.
Right edit changes the default multiplier from configuration.rate to 0; the supplied test only calls usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly") with an explicit multiplier, so the default path is untested.
Relationship states subscriptionCharge value-references chargeUnit and chargeUnit value-references usageCharge, linking the two edited symbols through a shared metering dependency.
assert.ok(await subscriptionCharge(40) > 0) only checks positivity; it does not verify the removed initialize call or the changed plan string, leaving the merged behavior underdetermined.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动共同触及计量依赖链，但现有测试未覆盖被删除的初始化副作用和默认倍率路径，合并后的行为存在实质不确定性。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts 的 subscriptionCharge 作者确认是否应保留 metering.initialize() 并将 plan 改回 "monthly"，同时请 src/metering.ts 的 usageCharge 作者确认默认 multiplier 是否应恢复为 configuration.rate。
